C1236.title: 2021: A Landmark Year for Antitrust Enforcement Against Alibaba, Meituan, and Tencent
C1236.summary: In 2021, China's antitrust enforcement intensified significantly. The annual enforcement report records major internet-platform cases including Alibaba's 18.228 billion yuan penalty for abusing market dominance, Meituan's 3.442 billion yuan penalty for “choose one from two” conduct, and Tencent Music and other platform cases. These actions show a broader tightening of antitrust oversight over platform-economy conduct.
